dependents.method: Inspect exact dependency-kind anchor elements in the retained anonymous GitHub HTML; remove nested SVG and HTML tags and require an explicit number beside Repositories/Packages. The extraction ran in this chat's JavaScript tool runtime.
limitations: GitHub's displayed dependents reflect its indexing; the site vendors an archive and is not thereby counted.
Zero displayed indexed dependents is not proof of no actual users.

registry.method: Actual official JSON contains empty servers and metadata.count 0, with no next cursor; this covers this search only.
limitations: No global Registry inventory or alternative-name search is claimed.
Metadata listings provide no installs or session counts.

citationDiscovery.method: Three exact-name web queries, followed by opening returned pages; results include package distribution metadata, automatic mirrors and unrelated same-name services.
limitations: These are discovery observations, not independently reviewed editorial adoption or a complete citing-domain census.
Distribution registries, token SDK/social mirrors, domain-lookup pages and zodiacs.ai are excluded from an engine adoption count.
No citing-paper count or zero is claimed.
